approval_ref: The active goal explicitly requires CRIP to manage local tasks, versions, results, citations and review around an advanced-model reference implementation.
notes: Freeze one terminal REFERENCE_QA run, snapshot, ordered question set and non-secret model profile per evaluation.
Creating, listing, reading and previewing evaluation tasks must make zero model calls.
Execute only one explicitly selected question per request through the existing QA V3 and result store; never add an automatic paid batch retry.
Keep legacy analysis and the existing single-question Reference QA workflow unchanged.
Do not read .local customer data, saved credentials or live provider state during offline validation.
title: Manage frozen Reference QA evaluation tasks
objective: Turn a bounded ordered question set into a frozen, resumable local Reference evaluation task whose questions explicitly execute through existing QA V3 and link to immutable saved results without changing legacy workflows.
